name: Windows 10
local_hint:
Put a Windows 10 ISO in the images folder, with "10" somewhere in the file name.
  Microsoft's page: https://www.microsoft.com/software-download/windows10
  Opened on Windows that page offers the Media Creation Tool instead of an ISO - run it, choose "Create installation media", then "ISO file".
  There is no link this mod could fetch: Microsoft signs a fresh one per browser session and refuses scripted clients, so this box waits for you instead.
  The licence to run it stays yours; this mod neither supplies one nor grants one.
notes: A registry entry with no URL, which is the honest shape rather than a gap. Microsoft's download endpoints are undocumented, mint a signed URL per browser session, and now reject scripted clients outright - Rufus's Fido helper is answered with 715-123130 where an interactive browser succeeds. So there is no URL to ship, not merely an unstable one, and a box that waits for a file is the honest shape. Windows 10 needs no TPM and no Secure Boot, which makes it the easier of the two to provision - but it left support in October 2025, so keep it behind the NAT-isolated network default and do not treat it as a machine you would expose. Every running Windows machine wants its own licence; cloning a template does not multiply one.
